boxes.meaning: to take in, absorb knowledge or information

examples.english: I need time to absorb this information.
examples.traditional: 我需要時間吸收呢啲資料。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 si4 gaan3 kap1 sau1 ni1 di1 zi1 liu2

examples.english: After reading the book, I need time to assimilate the new knowledge.
examples.traditional: 我睇完本書，要慢慢吸收啲新知識。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 jyun4 bun2 syu1 jiu3 maan6 maan6 kap1 sau1 di1 san1 zi1 sik1

examples.english: I consume a lot of information from the news every day.
examples.traditional: 我每日睇新聞，吸收好多資訊。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 tai2 san1 man4 kap1 sau1 hou2 do1 zi1 seon3

examples.english: The sponge can soak up all the water on the table quickly.
examples.traditional: 塊海綿好快吸收晒枱面啲水。
examples.jyutping: faai3 hoi2 min4 hou2 faai3 kap1 sau1 saai3 toi2 min6 di1 seoi2
